name: crypto-dca-planner
description: Monorepo root. Lets Railway build a chosen sub-app from the repo root without a Root Directory setting.

scripts.build:api: cd backend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.start:api: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/api/server.js
scripts.build:web: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
